signal: a 12-bar low knowable at bar t (lowest low of t-2..t at or below the lowest of t-11..t-3) and bar t completes DISPLACE_C up (MCFL v1, known_at = t); shorts on the flipped chart

costs: 0.07% of price a round trip; walks the real series' cost in ATR units at the same bar
data_primary: Binance USDT perpetuals that none of the turn studies used: the Binance replication's sets (binance.py SET_A and SET_B) minus the 12 coins of turn_trade.py, 4h and 1d, full history from data.binance.vision
